newsitem.title: INDIA: India modifies private pension fund rules.
newsitem.headline: India modifies private pension fund rules.

text.p: The Indian government said on Monday that it has taken steps to allow private pension funds to earn more on their investments.

The government said in a statement that it had partially modified the investment pattern applicable to non-government provident, superannuation and gratuity funds so that the funds could earn more on their investments.
Effective October 1, the government will reduce the required limit in special deposits to 20 percent from 30 percent, it said.

The investment in bonds or securities of public financial institutions, public sector companies and certificates of deposits of public sector banks has been increased to 40 percent from 30 percent, it said.
